interface.longDescription: Visualize and challenge your ideas. Find and read your owned Arkah boards, review a brief, and create a new board from your conversation. Explore a private, read-only Canvas/Reader preview in compatible hosts. Existing-board editing and publishing remain in Arkah.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare a brief for a new board.
